fn clamp(x: Int, lo: Int, hi: Int) -> Int
  requires (lo <= hi)
  ensures ((not (x < lo)) or (result == lo))
  ensures ((not (x > hi)) or (result == hi))
  ensures ((not ((x >= lo) and (x <= hi))) or (result == x))
  ensures ((result >= lo) and (result <= hi))
  effects pure
  example (clamp(5, 0, 10) == 5)
  example (clamp(-3, 0, 10) == 0)
  example (clamp(15, 0, 10) == 10)
  example (clamp(0, 0, 10) == 0)
  example (clamp(10, 0, 10) == 10)
  example (clamp(7, 7, 7) == 7)
  example (clamp(-8, -5, -2) == -5)
  example (clamp(-1, -5, -2) == -2)
{
  if (x < lo) then lo else if (x > hi) then hi else x
}

fn index_of(xs: List[Int], x: Int) -> Int
  requires contains(xs, x)
  ensures (((result >= 0) and (result < len(xs))) and (xs[result] == x))
  ensures forall i in 0..result: (xs[i] != x)
  effects pure
  example (index_of([4, 7, 9], 7) == 1)
  example (index_of([3, 3, 3], 3) == 0)
  example (index_of([1, 2, 3, 2], 2) == 1)
  example (index_of([5], 5) == 0)
{
  match xs { [h, ..t] => if (h == x) then 0 else (1 + index_of(t, x)) [] => 0 }
}

fn search(n: Int, x: Int) -> Int
  requires (n >= 0)
  requires (x >= 0)
  requires ((x * x) <= n)
  requires (x <= n)
  ensures (result >= 0)
  ensures ((result * result) <= n)
  ensures (((result + 1) * (result + 1)) > n)
  effects pure
  example (search(0, 0) == 0)
  example (search(1, 0) == 1)
  example (search(2, 0) == 1)
  example (search(15, 0) == 3)
  example (search(16, 0) == 4)
  example (search(17, 0) == 4)
  example (search(24, 0) == 4)
  example (search(25, 0) == 5)
  example (search(1000000, 0) == 1000)
{
  if (((x + 1) * (x + 1)) > n) then x else search(n, (x + 1))
}

  requires (n >= 0)
  ensures (result >= 0)
  ensures ((result * result) <= n)
  ensures (((result + 1) * (result + 1)) > n)
  effects pure

fn run_helper(xs: List[Int], current_run: Int, max_run: Int) -> Int
  requires (((len(xs) > 0) and (current_run >= 1)) and (max_run >= 1))
  ensures ((result >= max_run) and (result >= current_run))
  effects pure
  example (run_helper([1, 1, 2, 2, 2, 3], 1, 1) == 3)
  example (run_helper([7], 1, 1) == 1)
{
  match xs { [] => 1 [h, ..t] => match t { [] => if (current_run >= max_run) then current_run else max_run [s, ..rest] => if (h == s) then run_helper(t, (current_run + 1), max_run) else if (current_run >= max_run) then run_helper(t, 1, current_run) else run_helper(t, 1, max_run) } }
}

fn longest_run(xs: List[Int]) -> Int
  requires (len(xs) > 0)
  ensures ((result >= 1) and (result <= len(xs)))
  ensures exists i in 0..len(xs): (((i + result) <= len(xs)) and (forall j in 0..result: (xs[(i + j)] == xs[i])))
  ensures forall i in 0..len(xs): ((((i + result) + 1) > len(xs)) or (exists j in 0..(result + 1): (xs[(i + j)] != xs[i])))
  effects pure
  example (longest_run([1, 1, 2, 2, 2, 3]) == 3)
  example (longest_run([7]) == 1)
  example (longest_run([1, 2, 3]) == 1)
  example (longest_run([2, 2, 2, 2]) == 4)
  example (longest_run([1, 1, 2, 1, 1, 1]) == 3)
  example (longest_run([5, 5, 6, 6]) == 2)
{
  run_helper(xs, 1, 1)
}

fn max_subarray_kadane(xs: List[Int], current_sum: Int, max_sum: Int) -> Int
  requires (max_sum >= current_sum)
  ensures (result >= max_sum)
  effects pure
  example (max_subarray_kadane([], 5, 5) == 5)
  example (max_subarray_kadane([-2, 3, 4, -1], 1, 1) == 7)
{
  match xs { [] => max_sum [h, ..t] => if (h > (current_sum + h)) then max_subarray_kadane(t, h, if (h > max_sum) then h else max_sum) else max_subarray_kadane(t, (current_sum + h), if ((current_sum + h) > max_sum) then (current_sum + h) else max_sum) }
}

fn sub_sum(xs: List[Int], a: Int, b: Int) -> Int
  requires ((a <= b) and (b <= len(xs)))
  ensures ((a != b) or (result == 0))
  ensures ((((b - a) != 1) or (a < 0)) or (result == xs[a]))
  effects pure
  example (sub_sum([1, 2, 3], 0, 2) == 3)
  example (sub_sum([1, -2, 3], 1, 3) == 1)
  example (sub_sum([1], 0, 0) == 0)
  example (sub_sum([5, 6, 7], 1, 2) == 6)
{
  if (b <= 0) then 0 else match xs { [] => 0 [h, ..t] => ((if (a <= 0) then h else 0) + sub_sum(t, (a - 1), (b - 1))) }
}

fn max_subarray(xs: List[Int]) -> Int
  requires exists x in xs: (x > 0)
  ensures exists i in 0..len(xs): exists j in (i + 1)..(len(xs) + 1): (result == sub_sum(xs, i, j))
  ensures forall i in 0..len(xs): forall j in (i + 1)..(len(xs) + 1): (sub_sum(xs, i, j) <= result)
  effects pure
  example (max_subarray([1, -2, 3, 4, -1]) == 7)
  example (max_subarray([2, 2, -5, 1]) == 4)
  example (max_subarray([-3, 5, -1]) == 5)
{
  match xs { [] => 0 [h, ..t] => max_subarray_kadane(t, h, h) }
}

fn merge_sorted(xs: List[Int], ys: List[Int]) -> List[Int]
  requires sorted(xs)
  requires sorted(ys)
  requires forall x in xs: not contains(ys, x)
  ensures sorted(result)
  ensures (len(result) == (len(xs) + len(ys)))
  ensures forall x in xs: (count(result, x) == (count(xs, x) + count(ys, x)))
  ensures forall y in ys: (count(result, y) == (count(xs, y) + count(ys, y)))
  effects pure
  example (merge_sorted([1, 4, 9], [2, 3]) == [1, 2, 3, 4, 9])
  example (merge_sorted([], [5, 6]) == [5, 6])
  example (merge_sorted([5, 6], []) == [5, 6])
  example (merge_sorted([], []) == [])
  example (merge_sorted([1, 2, 3], [7, 8]) == [1, 2, 3, 7, 8])
  example (merge_sorted([-3, 0, 10], [-5, 4]) == [-5, -3, 0, 4, 10])
{
  match xs { [] => ys [h1, ..t1] => match ys { [] => xs [h2, ..t2] => if (h1 <= h2) then ([h1] ++ merge_sorted(t1, ys)) else ([h2] ++ merge_sorted(xs, t2)) } }
}

fn count_of(xs: List[Int], x: Int) -> Int
  requires (len(xs) >= 0)
  ensures (result == count(xs, x))
  effects pure
  example (count_of([1, 2, 2, 3], 2) == 2)
  example (count_of([], 4) == 0)
{
  match xs { [] => 0 [h, ..t] => if (h == x) then (1 + count_of(t, x)) else count_of(t, x) }
}

fn beats_all(all: List[Int], rest: List[Int], m: Int) -> Bool
  requires (len(rest) >= 0)
  ensures (result == (forall x in rest: ((x == m) or (count(all, x) < count(all, m)))))
  effects pure
  example (beats_all([1, 2, 2, 3], [1, 2, 2, 3], 2) == true)
  example (beats_all([1, 2, 2, 3], [1, 2, 2, 3], 1) == false)
  example (beats_all([1, 2], [], 1) == true)
{
  match rest { [] => true [h, ..t] => (((h == m) or (count_of(all, h) < count_of(all, m))) and beats_all(all, t, m)) }
}

fn find_mode_value(full: List[Int], candidates: List[Int]) -> Int
  requires ((((len(full) > 0) and (len(candidates) > 0)) and (forall x in candidates: contains(full, x))) and (exists m in full: forall x in full: ((x == m) or (count(full, x) < count(full, m)))))
  ensures (contains(full, result) and beats_all(full, full, result))
  effects pure
  example (find_mode_value([1, 2, 2, 3], [1, 2, 2, 3]) == 2)
  example (find_mode_value([5], [5]) == 5)
  example (find_mode_value([1, 1, 2, 2, 2], [1, 1, 2, 2, 2]) == 2)
{
  match candidates { [] => 0 [h, ..t] => if beats_all(full, full, h) then h else match t { [] => h _ => find_mode_value(full, t) } }
}

fn mode_ok(xs: List[Int], r: Option[Int]) -> Bool
  requires (len(xs) >= 0)
  ensures ((not result) or ((len(xs) == 0) == (r == None)))
  effects pure
  example (mode_ok([1, 2, 2, 3], Some(2)) == true)
  example (mode_ok([1, 2, 2, 3], Some(1)) == false)
  example (mode_ok([1, 2, 2, 3], Some(7)) == false)
  example (mode_ok([], None) == true)
  example (mode_ok([], Some(1)) == false)
  example (mode_ok([1], None) == false)
{
  match r { None => match xs { [] => true _ => false } Some(m) => ((count_of(xs, m) > 0) and beats_all(xs, xs, m)) }
}

fn most_frequent(xs: List[Int]) -> Option[Int]
  requires ((len(xs) == 0) or (exists m in xs: forall x in xs: ((x == m) or (count(xs, x) < count(xs, m)))))
  ensures ((len(xs) == 0) == (result == None))
  ensures mode_ok(xs, result)
  effects pure
  example (most_frequent([1, 2, 2, 3]) == Some(2))
  example (most_frequent([]) == None)
  example (most_frequent([5]) == Some(5))
  example (most_frequent([3, 1, 3, 2, 1, 3]) == Some(3))
{
  match xs { [] => None _ => Some(find_mode_value(xs, xs)) }
}

fn nth(xs: List[Int], i: Int) -> Option[Int]
  requires (i >= 0)
  ensures ((i >= len(xs)) or (result == Some(xs[i])))
  ensures ((i < len(xs)) or (result == None))
  effects pure
  example (nth([5, 6, 7], 1) == Some(6))
  example (nth([5, 6, 7], 0) == Some(5))
  example (nth([5, 6, 7], 2) == Some(7))
  example (nth([5, 6, 7], 3) == None)
  example (nth([], 0) == None)
  example (nth([5, 6, 7], 10) == None)
{
  if (i == 0) then match xs { [] => None [h, ..t] => Some(h) } else match xs { [] => None [_, ..t] => nth(t, (i - 1)) }
}

fn pow_ref(b: Int, e: Int) -> Int
  requires (e >= 1)
  ensures ((e != 1) or (result == b))
  ensures ((b != 0) or (result == 0))
  ensures ((b == 0) or (result != 0))
  effects pure
  example (pow_ref(2, 10) == 1024)
  example (pow_ref(-3, 3) == -27)
  example (pow_ref(0, 4) == 0)
  example (pow_ref(5, 1) == 5)
{
  if (e == 1) then b else (b * pow_ref(b, (e - 1)))
}

fn power(base: Int, exp: Int) -> Int
  requires (exp >= 1)
  ensures (result == pow_ref(base, exp))
  ensures ((exp != 1) or (result == base))
  ensures ((base != 0) or (result == 0))
  effects pure
  example (power(2, 10) == 1024)
  example (power(-3, 3) == -27)
  example (power(-2, 4) == 16)
  example (power(0, 5) == 0)
  example (power(1, 7) == 1)
  example (power(7, 1) == 7)
{
  if (exp == 1) then base else (base * power(base, (exp - 1)))
}

fn take(xs: List[Int], k: Int) -> List[Int]
  requires ((k >= 0) and (k <= len(xs)))
  ensures (len(result) == k)
  ensures forall i in 0..k: (result[i] == xs[i])
  effects pure
  example (take([1, 2, 3], 1) == [1])
  example (take([1, 2, 3], 2) == [1, 2])
  example (take([1, 2, 3], 0) == [])
{
  if (k == 0) then [] else match xs { [] => [] [h, ..t] => ([h] ++ take(t, (k - 1))) }
}

fn drop(xs: List[Int], k: Int) -> List[Int]
  requires ((k >= 0) and (k <= len(xs)))
  ensures (len(result) == (len(xs) - k))
  ensures forall i in 0..len(result): (result[i] == xs[(i + k)])
  effects pure
  example (drop([1, 2, 3], 1) == [2, 3])
  example (drop([1, 2, 3], 3) == [])
  example (drop([1, 2, 3], 0) == [1, 2, 3])
{
  if (k == 0) then xs else match xs { [] => [] [_, ..t] => drop(t, (k - 1)) }
}

fn rotate_left(xs: List[Int], k: Int) -> List[Int]
  requires ((k >= 0) and (k <= len(xs)))
  ensures (len(result) == len(xs))
  ensures forall i in 0..(len(xs) - k): (result[i] == xs[(i + k)])
  ensures forall i in 0..k: (result[((len(xs) - k) + i)] == xs[i])
  effects pure
  example (rotate_left([1, 2, 3, 4], 1) == [2, 3, 4, 1])
  example (rotate_left([1, 2, 3, 4], 3) == [4, 1, 2, 3])
  example (rotate_left([1, 2, 3, 4], 0) == [1, 2, 3, 4])
  example (rotate_left([1, 2, 3, 4], 4) == [1, 2, 3, 4])
  example (rotate_left([], 0) == [])
  example (rotate_left([5, 5, 7], 2) == [7, 5, 5])
{
  (drop(xs, k) ++ take(xs, k))
}

fn zip_sum(xs: List[Int], ys: List[Int]) -> List[Int]
  requires (len(xs) == len(ys))
  ensures (len(result) == len(xs))
  ensures forall i in 0..len(result): (result[i] == (xs[i] + ys[i]))
  effects pure
  example (zip_sum([1, 2, 3], [10, 20, 30]) == [11, 22, 33])
  example (zip_sum([], []) == [])
  example (zip_sum([5], [-5]) == [0])
{
  match xs { [] => [] [h, ..t] => match ys { [] => [] [h2, ..t2] => ([(h + h2)] ++ zip_sum(t, t2)) } }
}
